def greet_model(model_name):
    return f"Connecting to {model_name}..."

message = greet_model("gpt-4o")
print(message)
caption: No return statement? The function just returns None.

code:
def call_model(prompt, temperature=0.7, max_tokens=500):
    return f"temp={temperature}, tokens={max_tokens}"

call_model("Hello")
call_model("Hello", temperature=0.2)
caption: Call with just the required argument, or override any default.

eyebrow: Keyword arguments: how real SDKs expect calls
code:
call_model(
    prompt="Summarize this article",
    temperature=0.2,
    max_tokens=1000,
)
caption: Self-documenting and order-independent — exactly how AI SDKs read.
